Package com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.working

Class SessionPolicy

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.working.SessionPolicy
public final class SessionPolicy extends Object
Which orders may execute in which market session, and when a DAY order's day ends. Pure functions with no state, shared by order placement, OrderTriggerEngine and order edits.
  • REGULAR (9:30-16:00 ET): every order.
  • PRE_MARKET and AFTER_HOURS: only LIMIT orders placed for extended hours. Stops don't trigger and trailing stops don't trail on thin extended-hours prices.
  • CLOSED: nothing executes; orders wait for the next session they may trade in.

    • dayExpiry

      public static OffsetDateTime dayExpiry(OffsetDateTime placedAt, boolean extendedHours)
      When a DAY order stops working: at the end of the trading day it can next trade in - the regular close, or the end of after-hours for an extended-hours order. An order placed after that time today (or on a weekend or holiday) is good for the next trading day.
      Parameters:
      placedAt - when the order is placed
      extendedHours - whether it trades in extended hours
      Returns:
      its expiry

    • expiryOf

      public static OffsetDateTime expiryOf(Order.TimeInForce timeInForce, OffsetDateTime placedAt, boolean extendedHours, MarketClock marketClock)
      When an order with this time in force stops working, if it hasn't filled.
      Parameters:
      timeInForce - DAY or GTC
      placedAt - when it is placed (or its time in force changed)
      extendedHours - whether it trades in extended hours
      marketClock - the market clock; with market hours off, a DAY order lasts until midnight ET
      Returns:
      its expiry
